jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

Your role

• Provide legal and administrative support to the Legal Europe teams in Assets Servicing, Private Banking & General Legal Matter .

• Provide legal and administrative support to the Legal Europe teams and contribute to the efficient management of day-to-day activities.

• Assist lawyers in the preparation, review and follow-up of legal documentation, correspondence and internal records.

• Support the handling of sensitive legal and forensic matters, including requests from authorities and other confidential cases.

• Collect, organise and maintain documentation required for legal matters and investigations.

• Liaise with internal stakeholders, external counsel and public authorities when required.

• Conduct legal and regulatory research and assist in monitoring legal developments.

• Contribute to the proper management of legal risks and compliance with internal procedures.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Law or equivalent

• Minimum 5 years of experience within a bank, financial services or another regulated environment.

Technical skills:

• Good knowledge of corporate law, contract law and legal research methodologies.

• Understanding of the legal and regulatory requirements applicable to banking or financial services.

• Ability to manage sensitive and urgent legal requests within strict deadlines.

• Proficiency in legal research tools, document-management systems and in Microsoft Office with the ability to develop, optimise and automate templates, trackers and reporting tool.

• Strong drafting and written communication skills.

Soft skills:

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.

• High level of discretion and confidentiality.

• Resilience and ability to handle sensitive and complex situations.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact with demanding stakeholders.

• Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and workloads.

• Diplomatic, service-oriented and pragmatic mindset.

Language skills:

• German: fluent

• French: fluent

• Englich: fluent

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

• Raccogliere, organizzare e mantenere la documentazione necessaria per questioni legali e indagini.

• Liaise con parti interessate interne, consulenza esterna e autorità pubbliche quando necessario.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea in diritto o equivalente

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza all'interno di una banca, servizi finanziari o un altro ambiente regolamentato.

Competenze tecniche:

• Buona conoscenza del diritto societario, del diritto contrattuale e delle metodologie legali di ricerca.

• Comprensione dei requisiti legali e regolamentari applicabili ai servizi bancari o finanziari.

• Capacità di gestire richieste legali sensibili e urgenti entro scadenze rigorose.

• La competenza in strumenti di ricerca legale, sistemi di gestione dei documenti e in Microsoft Office con la capacità di sviluppare, ottimizzare e automatizzare modelli, tracker e strumento di reporting.

• Forte capacità di redazione e comunicazione scritta.

Capacità morbide:

• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Capacità di rimanere calmo ed efficace sotto pressione.

• Alto livello di discrezione e riservatezza.

• Resilienza e capacità di gestire situazioni sensibili e complesse.

• Forte capacità interpersonali e capacità di interagire con gli stakeholder esigenti.

• Capacità di adattarsi rapidamente alle mutevoli priorità e ai carichi di lavoro.

• Mindset diplomatico, orientato al servizio e pragmatico.

Capacità linguistiche:

• Tedesco: fluente

• Francese: fluente

• Englich: fluente

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will build “investment partnerships” with CRMs to deliver clients a unique investment experience aligned with their needs and geographical specificities. You will also assist CRMs in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most suitable investment solutions available (PWM, PAM and PAA).

Your role

• Communicating the investment platform’s strategy and solutions to CRMs, clients and prospects.
• Helping determine clients’ needs, identifying and developing new opportunities in partnership with CRMs, preparing investment/advisory proposals and portfolio reviews and helping convert prospects to clients.
• Developing, offering and servicing discretionary mandates and seeking to centralise their management.
• Overseeing advisory mandates, seeking to streamline positions and exposure and ensuring they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• Supporting the team head overall on various investment-related tasks.
This will entail:
• A full understanding of Pictet’s offering, policies and guidelines and attending relevant investment forums and presentations.
• An ability to present and defend the investment philosophy and mandate/product offering.
• Regular reviews of portfolios to monitor adherence to risk controls, compliance and client constraints.
• Executing and managing trade orders.
• Investing cash positions and managing, executing and reviewing client transactions.
• A full understanding and attribution of own advisory/managed portfolios’ performance.
• Knowledge of all available marketing documents and key resources within the Group.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree and a post-graduate degree such as a Master’s, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least seven years’ investment advisory/management experience; client-facing experience.
• Ideally cross asset class experience with bias towards equities, derivatives, structured products and knowledge in alternative investments would be an additional asset.
• Fluency in Italian or Spanish, and English, both written and spoken. Fluency in Portuguese is an asset.
• Excellent technical knowledge across asset classes, investment vehicles and the mandate/product offering.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficient, including knowledge of relevant software packages, on-line information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and used to working under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player but also able to work on one’s own.

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5200 people.

You will join the Infrastructure & Production department of the bank, responsible for designing, operating and evolving core infrastructures, including networks and security platforms. You will lead a team of experts, working closely with software and platform teams, business stakeholders and support functions.

Your role

As Head of Unit – Network & Security, you will own the vision, governance and operational excellence for your perimeter (Run & Change). You will ensure stability, performance, resilience and security of services, while driving infrastructure modernisation, AI adoption and network resilience. You will act as a senior technical and people leader, able to engage with business stakeholders, build and take strategic decisions and develop your teams.

Key responsibilities

Network resilience and security

• Strengthen the resilience of LAN and WAN networks, with a specific focus on emerging cyber threats and geopolitical risks.

• Ensure robust architectures, redundancy mechanisms and disaster recovery capabilities across your pe-rimeter.

• Work closely with security teams (SOC, CISO, architecture) to align your services with security policies, standards and regulatory requirements.

Production stability and continuous improvement

• Establish disciplined change management practices and a strong “open loop” culture to prevent and re-solve production issues effectively.

• Reduce recurring incidents by reinforcing root cause analysis, engaging teams in continuous improvement practices and ensuring corrective actions are documented, followed up and closed.

• Define and monitor KPIs/KRIs related to stability, incident recurrence and service quality for your perime-ter.

AI adoption and innovation

• Drive the adoption of AI technologies and implement AI-assisted capabilities within your department to in-crease efficiency and quality of deliverables.

• Promote and oversee the integration of AI-powered features into the platforms under your responsibility (e.g. automation, intelligent monitoring, smart routing).

Infrastructure modernisation and cloud

• Define and execute a structured plan to modernise existing network and security infrastructure, with clear milestones for reducing technical debt and legacy dependencies.

• Support and guide the adoption of cloud and hybrid architectures for network and security services, in line with Group strategy and architecture guidelines.

People leadership and collaboration

• Lead and develop heads of teams and teams of engineers and administrators (internal staff and external partners), ensuring clear roles, responsibilities and performance objectives.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency and continuous learning, especially around incident management and innovation.

• Collaborate with other infrastructure and application leaders to ensure coherent end-to-end solutions and effective communication.

Your profile

• University degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Engineering or equivalent.

• 8-12 years of experience in IT infrastructure within a banking or financial environment, including several years in leadership roles.

• Proven track record managing complex networks and security infrastructures in highly available and regu-lated environments.

• Strong knowledge of networking technologies and data centre/cloud network architectures.

• Solid understanding of security solutions (firewalls, SASE, Zero-Trust principles) and cybersecurity best practices.

• Proven experience with automation and scripting (e.g. PowerShell, Python, Ansible) to industrialise op-erations and support AI-assisted workflows.

• Recognised leadership, with the ability to inspire and manage multidisciplinary teams and external part-ners.

• Strong communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and senior management

• Strategic mindset, structured and solution-oriented, with a strong focus on risk management and prioriti-sation.

• Client-oriented, with a genuine sense of service and the ability to act as a trusted partner to business stakeholders.

• Fluent in English and French, both spoken and written.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are looking for a Fund Analyst to join our cross-asset Funds Research & Advisory team, covering the Global Equity and Fixed Income pod with an extended remit into Liquid Alternatives. This is an opportunity to work within a T-shaped analyst model — developing deep expertise in your core asset classes while contributing to cross-pod initiatives, governance frameworks, and firm-wide manager research output.

You will play a key role in fund selection, manager due diligence, and portfolio construction support, feeding directly into our Approved and Focus List governance process.

Your role

• Conduct qualitative and quantitative due diligence on Global Equity and Fixed Income funds, with additional coverage of Liquid Alternatives strategies (equity long/short, global macro, multi-strategy, market neutral, relative value).
• Maintain and update fund ratings, ensuring alignment with the fund research governance.
• Prepare manager meeting notes, due diligence reports, and recommendations for Approved/Focus List reviews and Discretionary PMs.
• Monitor fund performance, risk characteristics, and portfolio positioning against stated mandates and peer groups.
• Support the Funds Advisory function and Discretionary Mandates by translating research views into actionable guidance for the front office.
• Contribute to thematic research pieces and quarterly manager survey presentations as well as requests.
• Liaise directly with fund management companies (portfolio managers, product specialists) on strategy updates, liquidity terms, and operational due diligence points.
• Support regulatory and cross-border fund considerations (UCITS, AIFMD) relevant to fund selection and distribution.
• Deputise for pod colleagues as needed and contribute to cross-pod knowledge sharing.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or related field CFA (or progress toward), CAIA a plus given Liquid Alternatives focus.
• At least ten years 10 years in fund research, manager selection, or fund analyst role within a private bank, asset manager, fund-of-funds, or investment consultancy.
• Demonstrated experience covering Liquid Alternatives strategies (hedge fund style, UCITS-wrapped or offshore) alongside traditional long-only equity and/or fixed income funds.
• Solid understanding of the fund management business — how asset managers are structured, fee models, distribution channels, and operational due diligence considerations.
• Familiarity with fund governance frameworks (rating systems, approved lists, investment committees) is a strong plus.
• Fluent in English; French a strong asset given client and internal stakeholder base.
• Strong quantitative due diligence skills: performance attribution, risk decomposition, factor analysis.
• Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks (UCITS, AIFMD; Swiss LPCC/LSFin knowledge a plus).
• Comfortable with fund research tools/databases (e.g., Morningstar Direct, Factset, Bloomberg).
• Advanced Excel; PowerPoint proficiency for client- and committee-facing materials.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to distill complex fund analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Comfortable engaging directly with fund managers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborative mindset, able to work within a pod structure and contribute beyond a single asset class silo.
• Must be resident in Switzerland with a valid work permit.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Stiamo cercando un Fund Analyst per unirci al nostro team di ricerca e consulenza di fondi cross-asset, che copre il Global Equity e il Fixed Income pod con un esteso mandato in alternative liquide. Questa è un'opportunità per lavorare all'interno di un modello di analista a forma di T - lo sviluppo di competenze profonde nelle classi di asset core, contribuendo a iniziative cross-pod, quadri di governance e output di ricerca manager di ampia portata.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella selezione dei fondi, manager due diligence, e supporto per la costruzione del portafoglio, alimentandosi direttamente nel nostro processo di governance Approved and Focus List.

Il tuo ruolo

• Condurre due diligence qualitativa e quantitativa sui fondi Global Equity e Fixed Income, con una copertura aggiuntiva delle strategie Liquid Alternative (equity long/short, global macro, multistrategy, market neutral, relativo value).
• Mantenere e aggiornare le valutazioni dei fondi, garantendo l'allineamento con la governance della ricerca di fondo.
• Preparate le note di riunione del manager, i rapporti di due diligence e le raccomandazioni per le recensioni Approved/Focus List e i premi discrezionali.
• Monitorare le prestazioni del fondo, le caratteristiche di rischio e il posizionamento del portafoglio contro i mandati dichiarati e i gruppi pari.
• Sostenere la funzione consultiva dei fondi e i mandati discrezionali traducendo le opinioni di ricerca in una guida attuabile per l'ufficio anteriore.
• Contribuisci ai pezzi di ricerca tematici e alle presentazioni dei sondaggi trimestrali e alle richieste.
• Liaise direttamente con le società di gestione fondi (portfolio manager, specialisti del prodotto) sugli aggiornamenti di strategia, termini di liquidità e punti di due diligence operativi.
• Sostenere le considerazioni di fondo regolamentari e transfrontaliere (UCITS, AIFMD) rilevanti per la selezione e la distribuzione dei fondi.
• Deputare per i colleghi pod come necessario e contribuire alla condivisione di conoscenze cross-pod.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in finanza, economia, o relativo campo CFA (o progresso verso), CAIA a plus dato Liquid Alternative messa a fuoco.
• Almeno dieci anni 10 anni di ricerca di fondo, selezione di manager, o ruolo di analista di fondo all'interno di una banca privata, asset manager, fondo di fondi, o consulenza di investimento.
• Esperienza dimostrata che copre le strategie Liquid Alternatives (stile fondi di copertura, UCITS-wrapped o offshore) insieme a fondi tradizionali di capitale e/o di reddito fisso.
• Solida comprensione del business di gestione del fondo — come gli asset manager sono strutturati, modelli di tassa, canali di distribuzione e considerazioni di due diligence operative.
• La familiarità con i quadri di governance dei fondi (sistemi di raccolta, elenchi approvati, comitati di investimento) è un vantaggio forte.
• Fluente in inglese; francese un bene forte dato cliente e base di stakeholder interni.
• Forte capacità di due diligenza quantitativa: attribuzione delle prestazioni, decomposizione del rischio, analisi dei fattori.
• Conoscenze di lavoro dei pertinenti quadri normativi (UCITS, AIFMD; Swiss LPCC/LSFin conoscenza un plus).
• Confortevole con strumenti di ricerca fondi/base di dati (ad esempio Morningstar Direct, Factset, Bloomberg).
• Excel avanzato; competenza di PowerPoint per materiali client- e client-facing.
• Ottima comunicazione scritta e verbale, in grado di distillare analisi di fondo complesse in chiare raccomandazioni per gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Confortevole coinvolgimento diretto con i gestori di fondi e gli stakeholder interni.
• Mindset collaborativo, in grado di lavorare all'interno di una struttura pod e contribuire oltre un singolo asset class silo.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera con un permesso di lavoro valido.

Wir suchen einen Fondsanalysten, der sich unserem vermögensübergreifenden Research & Advisory-Team für Fonds anschließt und den Global Equity und Fixed Income-Pod mit einem erweiterten Aufgabenbereich bei Liquid Alternatives abdeckt. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, innerhalb eines T-förmigen Analystenmodells zu arbeiten und fundiertes Fachwissen in Ihren Kernanlagenklassen zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig zu Pod-übergreifenden Initiativen, Governance-Frameworks und unternehmensweiten Manager-Forschungsergebnissen beizutragen.

Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Fondsauswahl, der Manager Due Diligence und der Unterstützung beim Portfolioaufbau und fließen direkt in unseren Governance-Prozess für genehmigte und Focus List ein.

Deine Rolle

• Durchführung einer qualitativen und quantitativen Due-Diligence-Prüfung für Global Equity- und Fixed-Income-Fonds mit zusätzlicher Abdeckung der Liquid Alternatives-Strategien (Aktien-Long/Short, globales Makro, Multi-Strategie, Marktneutral, relativer Wert).
• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie Fonds-Ratings, um die Abstimmung mit der Fondsforschungs-Governance sicherzustellen.
• Bereiten Sie Manager-Meeting-Notizen, Due-Diligence-Berichte und Empfehlungen für genehmigte / Fokuslisten-Bewertungen und diskretionäre PMs vor.
• Überwachen Sie die Fondsperformance, die Risikomerkmale und die Portfoliopositionierung anhand der angegebenen Mandate und Peer-Gruppen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Fondsberatungsfunktion und diskretionäre Mandate, indem Sie Forschungsansichten in umsetzbare Leitlinien für das Front Office übersetzen.
• Tragen Sie zu thematischen Forschungsarbeiten und vierteljährlichen Präsentationen von Managerumfragen sowie Anfragen bei.
• Kontaktaufnahme mit Fondsverwaltungsgesellschaften (Portfoliomanager, Produktspezialisten) zu Strategie-Updates, Liquiditätsbedingungen und operativen Due-Diligence-Punkten.
• Unterstützung regulatorischer und grenzüberschreitender Fondsüberlegungen (OGAW, AIFMD), die für die Auswahl und den Vertrieb von Fonds relevant sind.
• Vertreten Sie bei Bedarf Pod-Kollegen und tragen Sie zum Austausch von Pod-übergreifendem Wissen bei.

Dein Profil

• Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder verwandten Bereich CFA (oder Fortschritt in Richtung), CAIA ein Plus gegeben Liquid Alternatives Fokus.
• Mindestens zehn Jahre 10 Jahre in Fondsforschung, Managerauswahl oder Fondsanalystenrolle bei einer Privatbank, einem Vermögensverwalter, einem Dachfonds oder einer Anlageberatung.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen mit Liquid Alternatives-Strategien (Hedgefonds-Stil, OGAW-umhüllt oder Offshore) neben traditionellen Long-Only-Aktien- und / oder Fixed-Income-Fonds.
• Solides Verständnis des Fondsmanagementgeschäfts - wie Vermögensverwalter strukturiert sind, Gebührenmodelle, Vertriebskanäle und operative Due-Diligence-Überlegungen.
• Die Vertrautheit mit Fund Governance Frameworks (Rating-Systeme, genehmigte Listen, Investment Committees) ist ein starkes Plus.
• Fließend in Englisch; Französisch ein starkes Kapital gegeben Kunden und interne Stakeholder-Basis.
• Starke quantitative Due-Diligence-Fähigkeiten: Leistungszuordnung, Risikozerlegung, Faktoranalyse.
• Kenntnisse der relevanten regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen (UCITS, AIFMD; Schweizer LPCC/LSFin-Wissen ein Plus).
• Komfortabel mit Fund Research Tools/Datenbanken (z.B. Morningstar Direct, Factset, Bloomberg).
• Advanced Excel; PowerPoint-Kenntnisse für kunden- und ausschussorientierte Materialien.
• Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation, in der Lage, komplexe Fondsanalysen in klare Empfehlungen für technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder zu destillieren.
• Komfortable direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Fondsmanagern und internen Stakeholdern.

Votre équipe

Pictet Wealth Management combine plus de 200 ans d'héritage bancaire suisse avec une expertise en investissement mondial. Le groupe de services financiers appartenant à des partenaires offre un service complet aux personnes et aux familles riches, y compris des solutions d'investissement discrétionnaires et consultatives et des services de bureau familial.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste de fonds pour nous joindre à notre équipe de recherche et de conseil sur les fonds d'immobilisations croisées, couvrant le module Global Equity and Fixed Income avec un mandat étendu en Solutions de remplacement liquides. Il s'agit d'une occasion de travailler dans le cadre d'un modèle d'analyste en forme de T – développer une expertise approfondie dans vos classes d'actifs de base tout en contribuant à des initiatives transversales, des cadres de gouvernance et des résultats de recherche de gestionnaires à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la sélection des fonds, la diligence raisonnable des gestionnaires et l'appui à la construction de portefeuilles, en vous inscrivant directement dans notre processus de gouvernance approuvé et de la liste de priorités.

Votre rôle

• Effectuer une diligence raisonnable qualitative et quantitative sur les fonds d'actions mondiales et les fonds à revenu fixe, avec une couverture supplémentaire des stratégies Liquid Alternatives (actions longues/courtes, macro mondiales, multistratégie, marché neutre, valeur relative).
• Maintenir et mettre à jour les cotes des fonds, en assurant l'alignement sur la gouvernance de la recherche du fonds.
• Préparer les notes de réunion des gestionnaires, les rapports de diligence raisonnable et les recommandations pour les examens des listes de points de vue et les MP discrétionnaires.
• Surveiller le rendement du fonds, les caractéristiques des risques et le positionnement du portefeuille par rapport aux mandats et aux groupes de pairs établis.
• Appuyer la fonction de consultation sur les fonds et les mandats discrétionnaires en transformant les points de vue de la recherche en lignes directrices pratiques pour le front office.
• Contribuer à des travaux de recherche thématiques et à des présentations trimestrielles de gestionnaires ainsi qu'à des demandes.
• Assurer la liaison directe avec les sociétés de gestion de fonds (gestionnaires de portefeuille, spécialistes des produits) sur les mises à jour de la stratégie, les conditions de liquidité et les points opérationnels de diligence raisonnable.
• Soutenir les considérations réglementaires et transfrontalières concernant la sélection et la distribution des fonds.
• Défendre les collègues de pod au besoin et contribuer au partage des connaissances entre les pod.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en finances, économie ou domaine connexe FCA (ou progrès vers), l'ACIA est une priorité plus donnée des solutions de rechange liquides.
• Au moins dix ans en recherche de fonds, sélection de gestionnaires ou rôle d'analyste de fonds au sein d'une banque privée, gestionnaire d'actifs, fonds de fonds ou conseil en investissement.
• Expérience démontrée concernant les stratégies Liquid Alternatives (style hedge funds, OPCVM-wapped ou offshore) ainsi que les fonds traditionnels à long terme et/ou à revenu fixe.
• Une bonne compréhension de l'activité de gestion du fonds - la façon dont les gestionnaires d'actifs sont structurés, les modèles de frais, les canaux de distribution et les considérations de diligence raisonnable opérationnelle.
• La connaissance des cadres de gouvernance des fonds (systèmes de notation, listes approuvées, comités d'investissement) est un atout important.
• Fluent en anglais; le français est un atout important pour les clients et les intervenants internes.
• Fortes compétences quantitatives en matière de diligence raisonnable : attribution du rendement, décomposition des risques, analyse des facteurs.
• Connaissances pratiques des cadres réglementaires pertinents (UCITS, AIFMD; Swiss LPCC/LSFin knowledge a plus).
• Confortable avec des outils de recherche et des bases de données (p. ex. Morningstar Direct, Factset, Bloomberg).
• Excel avancé; compétence PowerPoint pour les documents destinés aux clients et aux comités.
• Excellente communication écrite et verbale, capable de distiller l'analyse complexe du fonds en recommandations claires pour les intervenants techniques et non techniques.
